scope: HKEX C2 Part D paragraphs 28 (Scope 1/2 portions) and 29(a), 29(b)(i)-(iii), 29(c)
mandatory_context_quote: An issuer must disclose its Scope 1 greenhouse gas emissions and Scope 2 greenhouse gas emissions pursuant to paragraphs 28(a), 28(b) and 29 on a mandatory basis.
exclusions: Other C2 Parts/clauses, annual-report rules and full legal compliance
Underlying ledger accuracy, recalculation, gross-versus-net assurance
Bilingual/cross-report consistency beyond the chosen source report
Whether a claimed exception or relief is legally available; requires review
Complete regulatory update monitoring outside the selected block

checks.label: 兩項排放量單位
checks.rule_quote: expressed as metric tons of CO2 equivalent

checks.label: 數據期間是否為目標財年
是否清楚披露絕對總排放量而非淨抵銷值
checks.rule_quote: its absolute gross greenhouse gas emissions
checks.query: gross net offset absolute greenhouse emissions
checks.guidance: 數值或 Total GHG 標籤本身不能證明 absolute gross；核實是否扣除抵銷。

checks.label: GHG Protocol 2004 或有依據的替代計量標準
checks.rule_quote: measure its greenhouse gas emissions in accordance with the Greenhouse Gas Protocol: A Corporate Accounting and Reporting Standard (2004)
checks.query: Greenhouse Gas Protocol Corporate Accounting Reporting Standard 2004
checks.guidance: 條款另有管轄機關／另一上市交易所要求的替代方法例外。Scope 3 專屬註腳不能證明 Scope 1/2 採用此標準；來源只列排放因子或 AR4 亦不足。

checks.label: 計量方法披露
checks.rule_quote: the measurement approach, inputs and assumptions the issuer uses to measure its greenhouse gas emissions
checks.query: measurement approach operational control financial control greenhouse
checks.guidance: 辨識實際方法及適用排放範圍；僅列地區／因子不是完整計量方法。

checks.label: 輸入資料及假設披露
checks.rule_quote: the measurement approach, inputs and assumptions the issuer uses to measure its greenhouse gas emissions
checks.query: emission factors assumptions fuel refrigerants electricity inputs
checks.guidance: 因子來源可作部分支持，仍要評估輸入資料及假設是否充分；不能核實未取得的原始台帳。

checks.label: 選擇方法、輸入及假設的原因
checks.rule_quote: the reason why the issuer has chosen the measurement approach, inputs and assumptions it uses to measure its greenhouse gas emissions
checks.query: measurement reason chosen accuracy assumptions factors
checks.guidance: 引用來源不等於已解釋選擇原因；與本年度變更原因分開判斷。

checks.label: 計量方法、輸入及假設的變更及原因
checks.rule_quote: any changes the issuer made to the measurement approach, inputs and assumptions during the reporting period and the reasons for those changes
checks.query: updated emission factors improve accuracy changes
checks.guidance: 說明改過甚麼及為何；未提變更不能自行假設沒變。

checks.label: Scope 2 location-based 基準
checks.rule_quote: disclose its location-based Scope 2 greenhouse gas emissions
checks.guidance: 使用地區電力因子不自動等於已清楚披露 location-based；market-based 不能代替 location-based。
checks.workflow_follow_up: 確認並清楚披露 location-based Scope 2 及其計算依據；market-based 可按適用情況另列，不能代替 location-based 披露。

checks.label: 理解 Scope 2 所需合約文書資料
checks.rule_quote: provide information about any contractual instruments that is necessary to enable an understanding of the issuer’s Scope 2 greenhouse gas emissions
checks.query: Scope 2 contractual instruments renewable certificate electricity
checks.guidance: 先確認是否涉及相關合約及所需資訊；未找到描述不等於沒有合約或不適用。
